name: Device Simulator
description: Private iPhone, iPad and Android devices with shared task views and tools. Data survives idle shutdown. iOS: macOS 15+, Apple Silicon and Xcode. Android: Mac, Windows x64 or Linux x64; setup asks before downloading SDK components. iOS uses Baguette (Apache-2.0).
whenToUse: iOS Simulator, iPhone/iPad App installation and launch, real-touch testing, screenshots and UI inspection, waiting and recording changes, device state and logs, live views and batch testing.

environment.description: Read-only iOS and Android environment, runtime and model discovery. platforms reports readiness and errors. Use devices first for existing devices. Missing Android components are installed through settings after the user reviews sizes and licenses; this tool downloads nothing.

devices.description: Call first: list private devices. tasks/thisTask describe selection only; activeTasks/thisTaskActive describe task activity in the last 15 minutes. usage is active/idle/unknown; operation describes running work. Prefer this task’s recent devices. tasks=0 does not mean free; inspect running devices with unknown activity. Listing does not renew activity.

device.description: Manage private devices. create uses runtime/deviceType from environment (roughly 7–12 GB each); reuse a suitable device first. boot waits for readiness; screenshot=true optionally adds an image within budget. shutdown keeps data; rename changes its name. erase removes apps/data; delete removes the device: only at user request. activity renews task use for 15 min; release ends use without stopping apps/devices (not an exclusive reservation). Android import_media copies an absolute image/video path to Downloads (≤128 MiB); inspect copied, scanRequested, path and importError before retrying. Run switch applies; viewers and active tools prevent idle shutdown. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve operation results: check storage, do not repeat completed operations.

app.description: install: built iOS .app or single Android .apk; no AAB/split APK. Identical content skips; Android otherwise installs fully, iOS may sync. modeReason explains the choice. Poll returned jobs with install_status. info + appPath checks matchesLocal; comparisonError/verification=unconfirmed is not proof of a different build: do not reinstall automatically. launch relaunches by default; arguments/env are iOS-only. appLaunched=true confirms execution; check viewer.previewOpened. outcome=partial means retry viewer open only. screenshot=true adds an image within budget; screenshot.error preserves success. terminate stops; uninstall deletes app/data; open_url opens deep links (observe system confirmations). BUSY names active operation/device/job after at most 1s pre-execution wait; never replay uncertain mutations. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve results: inspect storage, do not repeat.

screenshot.description: Capture the current screen. Supported Cindy hosts attach the image; older hosts, or images still over 130 KB after JPEG compression, return only path: open it with your image tool before acting. Upright as the user sees it, with screen corners and Dynamic Island; by default 1 pixel = 1 view point, so image coordinates go straight to tap and gesture. grid=true overlays a labelled grid; region crops a rectangle; scale 2–3 for detail (divide coordinates by scale).

describe_ui.description: Read the on-screen elements (accessibility tree). Default: a compact list in reading order with role, text, id, frame and center in view points (tap the center directly). Filter with query/role; x,y returns what is under a point; mode=full returns the whole tree. Games and custom-drawn UIs without accessibility get the text read off the screen instead (source=ocr), with positions; use screenshot for icons without text. OCR failure is an error, not evidence that no text is visible.

tap.description: Real touch tap through the simulator's system touch path: no window, works while the Mac is locked, and the app receives a finger touch. Target an element by text or id (optional role, nth); in games, text matches the words read off the screen. Or tap a view point x,y (if the screen turned since you looked, it asks you to look again instead of tapping the wrong place). count=2 double-taps; duration≥0.5 long-presses. Returns the new elements about 0.6 s later (observe=ui); observe=screenshot attaches a screenshot. Never inject events into the app process. until=text waits for that text to appear (next page, dialog) instead of guessing settle. settle is 0–5 seconds, default 0.6; use until or wait_for for longer transitions.

gesture.description: Swipes and multi-finger gestures, also real touches. kind: swipe (from→to, or direction up/down/left/right; up = finger moves up, content advances); drag (hold for hold seconds, then move to to: drag and drop, reordering); pinch (center, from_spread→to_spread); pan (two fingers by [dx,dy]); edge (system edges: bottom = Home/app switcher, top = Notification or Control Center); scroll_to (swipe until the text or id element is fully visible, or report the end). View points; observe as in tap. settle is 0–5 seconds, default 0.6; use until or wait_for for longer transitions.

type_text.description: Type into the focused field. text: method=auto (default) pastes in regular apps (exact, any language) and, in games without accessibility, types US-keyboard characters key by key (switching a Pinyin or similar input source to English); or force paste or type. keys sends keys such as Enter, Escape, Backspace, Tab, up, a, cmd+A or shift+Tab; clear=true empties the field first. Check focus first and observe the result. Key-by-key typing keeps the on-screen keyboard hidden; in games Enter may submit, so tap an empty area to only end editing. observe and until work as in tap. Keys hide the screen keyboard. About 3 seconds after input, the plugin attempts to clear the hardware-keyboard record; refocus to check recovery. Use method=touch for overlap checks without restarting. method=touch cannot be combined with clear=true or keys.

press.description: Hardware buttons: home, lock, power, volume-up, volume-down, action, app-switcher, swipe-to-app-switcher, swipe-to-home, pull-down-to-notification-center, pull-down-to-lock-screen; duration holds it. release-input only releases stuck keys and stops repeats; it restarts nothing and closes no app.

wait_for.description: Return once a condition holds (up to 90 s) instead of fixed sleeps and repeated screenshots. text or id appears (gone=true: disappears; in games, the text read off the screen); stable=seconds: the screen changes less than tolerance (percent of pixels, default 0.5) for that long, optionally only within region; log=regex: a matching line in the app's log (with bundleId). screenshot=true attaches the screen. If it does not happen: met=false, the reason and the current screen; for game animation, a suggested tolerance. Images use the call’s remaining time budget; failure or exhausted budget preserves the wait result with screenshot.error. Request screenshot separately if needed. goalMet mirrors met; false means the condition was not met, not a passing acceptance check.

capture.description: Record frames before action (tool: tap, gesture, press, type_text, open_url or app_launch; args: its arguments), then for seconds (≤15) afterwards. Deduplicate frames into a time-ordered contact sheet labelled in milliseconds plus frame files. For transitions, animation, toasts and loading; omit action to record current changes. Supported hosts attach sheets up to 130 KB; otherwise open the sheet path with an image tool. Requires fixed orientation, size and panel, checked before/after action and recording; per-frame rotation tracking is unsupported. All stages share this call’s deadline. Capture failure or exhausted time returns captureError (code, message) with action or actionError and execution retained. actionError includes code, message and execution. Inspect executed/unknown outcomes; never blindly repeat the action. The action starts only after a complete first frame and screen confirmation; failure before then returns captureError with execution=not_executed.

set_state.description: Change device state, several at once: orientation; posture for foldables (closed/open/flat or degrees); appearance light/dark; contrast; text_size (Dynamic Type); network (profile name, offline, clear or {latency, bandwidth, loss}; applies to apps launched afterwards); location {lat, lon} or clear; status_bar clean (9:41, full bars and battery, for screenshots) or clear; privacy {action grant/revoke/reset, service, bundleId} to pre-answer permission prompts. Changing a permission terminates that app; set it before launch. All steps and readbacks share the request deadline. applied lists completed fields; failure or expiry stops later steps and returns stateError with field, code, message and execution. Inspect that field before retrying; do not replay the entire request. Screen information after orientation/posture changes is returned only when confirmed within the remaining time; null in current means unconfirmed.

logs.description: Read an app's recent log and crash reports. bundleId or process selects it; last_seconds defaults to 120; level error (errors and faults only), default, info or debug; match filters by regex. Includes this device's recent crash summaries for that process by default (exception, reason, crashed-thread frames). If diagnostic reads fail or run out of time, logs are retained and crashesError (code, message) is returned instead of an empty crashes list. crashes=false skips diagnostics.

heal.description: Explicit Baguette repair for iOS 27 input shadowed by Device Hub, using simctl on the private device set. Restarts SpringBoard and terminates running apps; call only after the user accepts that. Try press(release-input) first for stuck keys.

viewer.description: Open/close the task live view; check previewOpened. Closing leaves devices/apps running. Switching only selects; stopped devices need Open. User controls: touch, keyboard, wheel/pinch, clipboard (replaces computer/device text), file/app install (may overwrite apps), rotate, shake, screenshot and start/stop. Android: APK/image/video import up to 128 MiB; silent WebM recording up to 5 min/128 MiB, letterboxed on rotation. iOS advanced tools: location/motion, status bar, persistent network, camera input, notifications (may trigger app behavior), accessibility, logs and video export (may contain private app data); map requests go via proxy to OpenStreetMap. Disclose these before opening; opening performs none of them. Loopback only. taskBindingError/appContextError preserve results; inspect records. outcome=partial: follow nextAction, retry viewer only.
